records.summary: Pinterest exposes a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 authorization-code, client-credentials, and refresh-token grants. API access is approval-based: approved apps receive Trial access and Standard access requires review. Pinterest documents its own MCP server, but the current page is prelaunch and asks users to watch for launch.
records.blocker: Trial access is limited and Standard upgrade requires a reviewed demo and compliance with developer guidelines. The MCP server is not yet launched, so early-access marketing should not be treated as generally available execution access.
records.next_action: Register a Pinterest app, request the least-privilege read/write scopes, implement authorization-code OAuth, and test in Trial access. Prepare the OAuth demo and apply for Standard access when production use is needed; monitor the official MCP page for launch availability.
